info.title: GC Stats API
info.description: Read only stats API for teams and players. Send an `x-api-key` header on every request, get a key from the dashboard.

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key issued from the dashboard, sent on every request.

atk.description: Keyed by "<your alive count>v<enemy alive count>" (e.g. "3v2"), from 0v0 to 5v5.

def.description: Keyed by "<your alive count>v<enemy alive count>" (e.g. "3v2"), from 0v0 to 5v5.

format.description: Always null — a V2 stage has no single format (cf. tournament.phase → stages).

parent_id.description: Always null — a V2 stage has no parent.

radar_chart_widget_url.description: Absolute URL to the OBS head to head radar chart widget for these two teams, null if either side is a bye/TBD.

last_tournaments.description: Last 10 tournaments the team registered for, most recent first. W/L counts decided matches only.

placement.description: Final placement, null when none is recorded.

team_name.description: Team name at the time: as of the last day of the stint for past teams, current name otherwise.

allOf.description: Team logos at the time (last day of the stint for past teams), current logos otherwise.

pronouns.description: Pronouns set on the profile, null when unset.

is_claimed.description: True when the profile is linked to a GC-Stats account (the account itself is never exposed).

roles.description: Staff roles the person held on the team during the tournament.

TournamentTeamMapStats.description: Present only when the `team_id` filter is given: that team's winrate, side split and comps for this map.
